title: falak.yaml
description: Falak config as code, version 1: the deployable units of one repository and their per-environment overrides (docs/plans/CONFIG_AS_CODE.md, "Phase 0 contract"). Secrets are never written here: use ${{ secrets.NAME }} in env values.

$schema.description: The schema of this file, for editors: https://falak.sh/schema/v1.json.

version.description: Schema version of this file. Always 1.

units.description: The deployable units of the repository, by key. A key is the unit's service name on the project canvas and the name ${{ <unit>.KEY }} references use.

environments.description: Project environments this file deploys to, by environment slug, each with the branch that feeds it, its servers and overrides of units.

unitKey.description: Unit key: lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter, at most 63 characters. "secrets" is reserved.

environmentKey.description: Environment slug (as in the project's URL): lower-case letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter.

resourceName.description: The name of an organization resource that must already exist (storage provider, DNS credential, certificate...). Named only, never defined here.

serverName.description: The name of a server already attached to the project.

servers.description: Names of servers already attached to the project. The first one leads (migrations, the scheduler).

duration.description: A duration: whole numbers with a unit, largest unit first, e.g. 30s, 5m, 1h30m, 2d. Units: d (days), h (hours), m (minutes), s (seconds).

size.description: A size in binary units: a number and k, m, g or t (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB), optionally followed by b or ib, any case, e.g. 512m, 1g, 1.5G, 20GiB.

cron.description: A 5-field cron expression (minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week), evaluated in UTC unless a timezone is given.

scheduleExpression.description: When the job runs: a 5-field cron expression, @hourly, @daily, @weekly, @monthly, @yearly, or "@every <duration>" (Go duration, at least 1s, e.g. @every 90s).

relativePath.description: A path relative to the repository root (or to the unit's root): no leading slash, no . or .. segments.

cidr.description: An IPv4 or IPv6 address or CIDR range, e.g. 203.0.113.0/24.

unixUser.description: The unix user the process runs as: always the unit's site user. Leave it out, or set it to exactly that user; any other user is refused (value.forbidden).

envValue.description: A value, or references: ${{ secrets.NAME }} (the secret store) and ${{ <unit>.KEY }} (another unit's variable; database units expose DATABASE_URL, DB_CONNECTION, DB_HOST, DB_PORT, DB_DATABASE, DB_USERNAME, DB_PASSWORD; redis units REDIS_URL, REDIS_CLIENT, REDIS_HOST, REDIS_PORT, REDIS_PASSWORD). Integers and booleans become their text (true, false, 42).

env.description: Environment variables. Never put secret values here: use ${{ secrets.NAME }}.

processEnv.description: Extra environment variables of this process, on top of the unit's (which it already sees). Literal values only: references are resolved in the unit's env, not here.

hostname.description: A lower-case host name; *.example.com for a wildcard.

domain.description: A domain: just the host name, or an object with its options.

primary.description: The primary domain (APP_URL, links). Default: the first domain in the list.

www.description: www redirect: none, to_www (apex → www) or to_apex (www → apex). Default none.

tls.description: Certificates: auto (ACME HTTP), dns (ACME DNS challenge, needs dns_credential; required for wildcards), custom (an uploaded certificate), internal (Caddy's internal CA), off (plain HTTP). Default auto.

dns_credential.description: tls: dns: the name of an existing DNS credential.

certificate.description: tls: custom: the name of an existing uploaded certificate.

cloudflare.description: Cloudflare options, for a domain in a Cloudflare zone Falak manages.

proxied.description: Proxy through Cloudflare (orange cloud). Default: the zone's default.

cache.description: Cache rule: standard, everything or bypass.

domains.description: Domains served by this unit. The first is the primary unless one says primary: true.

to.description: An absolute URL or a path starting with /.

headers.description: Response headers added to every response, by name.

mounts.description: Paths of this unit's domains served by a function unit (e.g. /api → the api function).

path.description: Path prefix, starting with / and without a trailing slash.

function.description: The key of a function unit.

strip_prefix.description: Remove the prefix before calling the function. Default true.

limits.description: Resource limits. Unset values take the environment's defaults (or no limit).

memory.description: Hard memory limit (whole MiB, at least 32m).

memory_reservation.description: Memory kept for this service (whole MiB, at most the limit).

max_restarts.description: on-failure: give up after so many restarts (1 to 1000).

log.description: Log rotation of the service's output.

max_size.description: Size of one log file (whole MiB, 1m to 10g).

oom.description: protect: the kernel kills other processes first when memory runs out.

health.description: The health check a release must pass to go live.

path.description: Path the deploy (and a blue/green swap) requests on the new release before it goes live; the edge doesn't use it. Default: the unit's health_path, else /.

timeout.description: Time for one attempt (1s to 2m). Default 10s.

retries.description: Attempts before the deploy fails (1 to 30). Default 3.

watch.description: Watch a release after it goes live and roll back (or alert) on a trigger. Setting this block turns watching on unless enabled: false.

enabled.description: Default true when the block is present.

minutes.description: How long to watch (1 to 60). Default 5.

health.description: Trigger: the health check fails health_failures times in a row. Default true.

crashes.description: Trigger: an OOM kill or a restart loop. Default true.

errors.description: Trigger: the 5xx rate goes above max(baseline × 3, 5%). Default true.

issues.description: Trigger: a new error issue in Insights. Default false.

hooks.description: Shell commands run during a deploy, in the release directory: the sections of the deploy script around $FALAK_FETCH, $FALAK_ACTIVATE and $FALAK_RESTART_PROCS.

before_fetch.description: Before the new release is fetched.

before_activate.description: After fetch and build, before the release goes live (e.g. php artisan migrate --force).

after_activate.description: After the release is live, before processes restart.

strategy.description: zero-downtime, in-place, rolling or canary for host runtimes; blue-green, rolling or canary for docker; compose, rolling or canary for compose units. Default: the first of those.

batch_size.description: rolling: servers switched at a time (1 to 100). Default 1.

keep_releases.description: Releases kept on each server for rollbacks (1 to 50). Default 5.

secrets.description: docker runtime: env (default) or files (secret variables as /run/secrets files).

encryption.description: Encryption of backups: cp (keys held by the control plane, default) or customer (encrypted to your age recipient; only you can restore).

databaseBackups.description: A backup schedule of this database instance.

storage.description: The name of an existing storage provider.

keep.description: Keep at most this many successful backups per database (1 to 1000).

keep_days.description: Delete successful backups older than this many days (1 to 3650).

databases.description: Databases backed up. Default: all of this unit's databases.

drill.description: Restore drills: off (default), weekly or monthly.

drill_query.description: SQL engines: a read-only SELECT that must return rows after a drill restore.

drill_server.description: Another server of the organization to run drills on.

volumeBackups.description: A backup schedule of this volume.

storage.description: The name of an existing storage provider.

keep.description: Keep at most this many successful backups (1 to 1000).

keep_days.description: Delete successful backups older than this many days (1 to 3650).

consistency.description: none (default), pause or stop the services using the volume while it is archived.

drill.description: Restore drills: off (default), weekly or monthly.

drill_server.description: Another server of the organization to run drills on.

volume.description: A volume and where it is mounted. Volumes are never deleted automatically.

kind.description: docker (a Docker named volume, default) or sized (a fixed-size volume, needs size).

mount.description: Absolute path in the container (docker runtimes and compose services).

service.description: compose units: the compose service it is mounted in.

protected.description: Refuse deleting the volume until this is turned off. Default false.

server.description: The server it lives on. Default: the unit's first server.

volumes.description: Volumes of this unit, by name.

worker.description: A queue worker: php artisan queue:work on PHP runtimes, or command.

timeout.description: Job timeout (0s = none, at most 1d). Default 60s.

sleep.description: Sleep when the queue is empty (at most 1h). Default 3s.

tries.description: Attempts per job (0 = unlimited, at most 1000). Default 1.

backoff.description: Wait before retrying a failed job (at most 1d).

max_jobs.description: Restart after this many jobs (0 to 1000000).

max_time.description: Restart after running this long (at most 7d).

memory.description: Memory a worker may use before it restarts (whole MiB, 32m to 64g). Default 128m.

servers.description: Run only on these servers of the unit. Default: all of them.

daemon.description: A long-running command supervised on the unit's servers.

directory.description: Working directory. Default: the current release.

stop_signal.description: Signal sent to stop it. Default TERM.

stop_timeout.description: Wait after the stop signal before killing (1s to 1h). Default 30s.

servers.description: Run only on these servers of the unit. Default: all of them.

schedule.description: A scheduled job of the unit (on the leader server unless all_servers).

overlap.description: skip (default): don't start while the previous run is still going; allow.

timeout.description: Kill a run after this long (1s to 1d). Default 1h.

heartbeat.description: Alert on missed or failed runs. Default true.

all_servers.description: Run on every server of the unit instead of the leader. Default false.

functionSchedule.description: A schedule of a function: runs its scheduled() handler on the leader server.

timeout.description: Kill a run after this long. Default 5m.

processKey.description: Process name: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores, at most 64 characters.

mode.description: native (Railpack on a builder, default), docker (an image from a Dockerfile) or on-server (built on each server).

dockerfile.description: docker: the Dockerfile, relative to the unit's root. Default Dockerfile.

laravel.description: Laravel processes Falak runs for you.

scheduler.description: Run php artisan schedule:run every minute on the leader. Default false.

octane.description: Serve with Octane: false (default), frankenphp, swoole or roadrunner.

root.description: The unit's directory in the repository. Default "." (the root). A push changing files under it redeploys the unit.

expose.description: Variables exported to the deploy hooks and the build (public front-end prefixes such as VITE_ and NEXT_PUBLIC_ always are).

composeService.description: Falak settings of one compose service.

port.description: Makes the service public: the port it listens on inside its container.

health_path.description: Path checked before it goes live.

domains.description: Domains of this service (needs port). The unit's own domains go to its first public service.

replace_with.description: Run this service as a Falak-managed database instead: the key of a database or redis unit. Its references are rewritten to that unit.

databaseCommon.$comment: Fields shared by database and redis units (referenced by both, never on its own).

version.description: Major version, e.g. "17" (PostgreSQL), "8.4" (MySQL), "11.4" (MariaDB), "8" (Redis), "8.1" (Valkey). Default: the newest Falak supports. Quote it.

server.description: The server it runs on. Default: the environment's first server.

memory.description: Memory limit; the engine is tuned to it (whole MiB, at least 16m).

disk.description: Size of its data volume (whole GiB, 1g to 16t). Default: a Docker volume without a size.

public.description: Publish the port publicly (only to allowed_sources). Default false. Turning it on needs an approval.

unit.description: A deployable unit. type picks its fields: app, compose, function, database or redis.

type.description: app (a site), compose (a Docker Compose stack), function (a cloud function), database (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB) or redis (Redis, Valkey).

appUnit.description: A site: PHP, Node, Bun, Deno, static or a Docker image.

runtime.description: frankenphp, php-fpm, node, bun, deno, static or docker.

framework.description: Framework (sets defaults such as the web directory). Default: detected.

node.description: Node.js major version, e.g. "22". Quote it.

web_directory.description: Public directory served, relative to the unit's root (e.g. public, dist).

port.description: docker runtime: the port the app listens on inside its container.

image.description: docker runtime: deploy this prebuilt image instead of building (e.g. ghcr.io/acme/web:1.2).

health_path.description: The unit's health path: deploys wait for it on the new release (unless deploy.health.path is set), and the edge checks it to keep each server in rotation (2xx only). Default: deploys check /, the edge checks nothing.

test_domain.description: Serve on the installation's test domain too. Default true.

servers.description: Servers of this unit. Default: the environment's servers.

composeUnit.description: A Docker Compose stack from the repository.

files.description: Compose files relative to the unit's root, in -f order. Default: compose.yaml (or docker-compose.yml).

test_domain.description: Serve public services on the installation's test domain too. Default true.

servers.description: Servers of this unit. Default: the environment's servers.

services.description: Falak settings of compose services, by service name.

functionUnit.description: A cloud function: its code is the files under root.

runtime.description: bun, node, deno, python or go.

entrypoint.description: The entry file, relative to root. Default: the runtime's (index.ts, main.py, main.go...).

servers.description: Servers of this unit. Default: the environment's servers.

concurrency.description: Requests one instance handles at once (1 to 10000). Default 50.

idle_timeout.description: Stop an idle instance after (10s to 1d). Default 5m.

memory.description: Memory per instance (whole MiB, 64m to 16g). Default 256m.

cpus.description: CPU cores per instance (0.1 to 16). Default 0.5.

access.description: Who may call it. API keys are created in the dashboard, never here.

allow.description: Only these addresses may call it.

schedules.description: Schedules of the function, by name.

databaseUnit.description: A managed PostgreSQL, MySQL or MariaDB instance. Never deleted automatically.

engine.description: postgresql, mysql or mariadb. A run never changes it (a new engine is a new unit).

databases.description: Databases in the instance. Default: one named after the unit key (dashes as underscores).

pitr.description: Point-in-time recovery: continuous archiving to storage.

enabled.description: Default true when the block is present.

storage.description: The name of an existing storage provider.

window_days.description: Recovery window in days (1 to 35). Default 7. Shrinking it needs an approval.

base_interval_days.description: A new base backup every so many days (1 to 35). Default 1.

redisUnit.description: A managed Redis or Valkey instance. Never deleted automatically.

engine.description: redis (default) or valkey. A run never changes it (a new engine is a new unit).

unitOverride.description: Overrides of a unit in this environment, merged over the unit (maps merge, lists replace, null removes). null removes the unit from this environment. A key not in units adds an environment-only unit (it needs type). The merged unit is validated as a whole.

type.description: Only for a unit this environment adds; must not change an existing unit's type.

environment.description: A project environment this file deploys to.

branch.description: A push to this branch applies the file to this environment. Without it, the environment is applied only from the CLI or the dashboard.

production.description: A production environment: risky changes to it need an approval. Default: the environment's current flag (false for a new one).

units.description: Overrides of units in this environment, by unit key.

previewUnit.description: include (default): a copy runs in the preview; share: the preview uses the base environment's; omit: left out. Database units take an object with the data strategy.

strategy.description: empty (default), clone_backup (the latest backup of source) or clone_sanitize (that backup, then sanitize).

source.description: The environment whose backup is cloned. Default: base.

sanitize.description: clone_sanitize: SQL or a command run on the copy.

previews.description: Preview environments for pull requests. A PR's preview uses the PR branch's file (fork PRs: the base branch's).

enabled.description: Default true when the block is present.

base.description: The environment previews copy (required when enabled).

units.description: What each unit does in a preview, by unit key. Unlisted units: include.

server.description: The server previews run on. Default: the base environment's first server.

fork_server.description: A server for previews of pull requests from forks only.

variables.description: Variables previews copy from the base environment's units.

domain_pattern.description: Host label of a preview under the organization's preview domain; must hold {number} and {service} ({project} also works). Default pr-{number}-{service}.

max_concurrent.description: Previews running at once (1 to 50). Default 5.

idle_ttl.description: Delete a preview idle this long (whole hours, 1h to 30d). Default 3d.

access.description: basic (default: HTTP basic auth) or public.

acknowledge_shared_database.description: Allow sharing a database unit with the base environment (previews then write to it). Default false.
